calls.title: Scott / Alyssa 1:1
calls.summary: Participants discussed various topics including personal updates about July 4th activities, followed by Alyssa’s completion of AI tracing documentation for SEO and AEO accuracy, pending approval from Graham. Concerns were raised regarding the productization of tracing and the complexity of observability data. The forthcoming 5.0 product release lacks a strong narrative, with the 4.4 release perceived as more substantial. Emphasis was placed on developing messaging for the Growth Book aimed at non-developers and growth teams. Additionally, the tutorial workflow was addressed, highlighting the process of creating PRs and planning distribution. Strategic goals for product marketing focusing on velocity, positioning, and sales enablement were discussed, alongside a call for Alyssa to draft a similar framework for developer relations.
calls.keywords: AI tracing, product marketing, version release, Growthbook positioning, tutorial creation, user outreach
